tutorial.info: Round, caller (Hakim), trump suit, and each team's points are shown here. A team taking 7 or more of the 13 tricks wins the round and scores a Sar (+1 point). Sweeping all tricks or winning consecutive rounds adds a Court bonus (+2). The first team to the target points (default 7) wins.
tutorial.trick: Cards played to the current trick appear here. Follow the led suit. Trumps beat plain cards, and within a suit the order is A > K > Q > J > ... > 2.
tutorial.hand: This is your hand. During play, click a playable card and press Play.
tutorial.actions: In the trump-declaration phase, if you are the caller declare a trump with the ♠♣♥♦ buttons. During play, pick a playable card and press Play, then advance with Next Trick / Next Round between tricks and rounds.
